incident: The frozen analyzer aborted before writing any analysis output because the empty-response paired-exclusion sensitivity left at least one model-by-intervention matched/nonmatched contrast unestimable.
decision_rule: For any frozen exclusion sensitivity with a zero retained model-by-intervention-by-paradigm cell, report estimable=false, the excluded-pair and minimum-retained-item counts, a machine-readable failure reason, and null gamma, preservation ratio, S values, and bootstrap. Its confirmatory component is false because the frozen rule requires a defined preservation ratio and at least three retained items in every required cell.
prohibited_repairs: do not convert empty responses to zero within the exclusion sensitivity
do not drop models, interventions, paradigms, or families
do not alter the primary score or any frozen threshold
scope: Reporting and fail-closed estimability handling only. The closed 19,656-record raw run, frozen analyzer, primary estimand, secondary estimands, bootstrap seeds, thresholds, and all estimable sensitivity calculations remain unchanged.
